name: acme
description: Sample team plugin marketplace for coding agents: one source, native manifests for every tool

plugins.name: acme-platform
plugins.description: Read-only GitOps status MCP for prod and test (a bundled mock), a rollout checklist skill, and an end-of-session reminder hook.

plugins.name: acme-knowledge
plugins.description: Wires the agent to the team's shared knowledge repo: a setup skill for the acme-kb CLI and a Stop hook that suggests a capture after infrastructure work.
